# Resource: stripe_issuing_personalization_design

The look of a physical Issuing card: its physical bundle, card logo and carrier letter. Stripe issues cards only for a platform's connected accounts, so manage designs through a provider configuration whose `stripe_account` is a connected account with the `card_issuing` capability active. `card_logo` is the ID of a file uploaded with the purpose `issuing_logo`, which a bundle whose `features.card_logo` is `required` needs; Terraform cannot upload files. Stripe reviews a new design: `status` reads `review` until Stripe makes it `active` or `rejected`, with its reasons in `rejection_reasons`. A plan that changes `physical_bundle`, `card_logo` or `carrier_text` of an existing design fails: create a new design instead.

~> Stripe cannot delete a personalization design, so `terraform destroy` leaves it on the connected account, and its `lookup_key` stays taken. A replacement that keeps the `lookup_key` therefore fails: give the new design another key in the same change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "issuing_account" {
  type        = string
  description = "A connected account with the card_issuing capability active."
}

variable "card_logo" {
  type        = string
  description = "A 1000 by 200 pixel black and white PNG uploaded to the connected account with the purpose issuing_logo."
}

# Issuing runs on a connected account, so a second provider configuration acts on it.
provider "stripe" {
  alias          = "issuing"
  stripe_account = var.issuing_account
}

resource "stripe_issuing_personalization_design" "standard" {
  provider        = stripe.issuing
  physical_bundle = "ics_1MvSieLkdIwHu7ixUjlsa0iP"
  card_logo       = var.card_logo
  name            = "Standard card"
  lookup_key      = "standard_card"

  carrier_text = {
    header_title = "Welcome"
    header_body  = "Your new card is enclosed."
    footer_title = "Questions"
    footer_body  = "Contact support."
  }
}

# A new design is in review until Stripe makes it active or rejects it.
output "design_status" {
  value = stripe_issuing_personalization_design.standard.status
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `physical_bundle` - (Required) The physical bundle object belonging to this personalization design.

The following arguments are optional:

* `card_logo` - (Optional) The file for the card logo, for use with physical bundles that support card logos. Must have a `purpose` value of `issuing_logo`.
* `carrier_text` - (Optional) Hash containing carrier text, for use with physical bundles that support carrier text. See [`carrier_text`](#carrier_text) below.
* `lookup_key` - (Optional) A lookup key used to retrieve personalization designs dynamically from a static string. This may be up to 200 characters.
* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
* `name` - (Optional) Friendly display name.

<a id="carrier_text"></a>
### `carrier_text`

The `carrier_text` attribute supports:

* `footer_body` - (Optional) The footer body text of the carrier letter.
* `footer_title` - (Optional) The footer title text of the carrier letter.
* `header_body` - (Optional) The header body text of the carrier letter.
* `header_title` - (Optional) The header title text of the carrier letter.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `preferences` - See [`preferences`](#preferences) below.
* `rejection_reasons` - See [`rejection_reasons`](#rejection_reasons) below.
* `status` - Whether this personalization design can be used to create cards. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`, `rejected`, `review`.

<a id="preferences"></a>
### `preferences`

The `preferences` attribute supports:

* `is_default` - Whether we use this personalization design to create cards when one isn't specified. A connected account uses the Connect platform's default design if no personalization design is set as the default design.
* `is_platform_default` - Whether this personalization design is used to create cards when one is not specified and a default for this connected account does not exist.

<a id="rejection_reasons"></a>
### `rejection_reasons`

The `rejection_reasons` attribute supports:

* `card_logo` - The reason(s) the card logo was rejected.
* `carrier_text` - The reason(s) the carrier text was rejected.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

Run the import where the resource's `provider` acts on the connected account that holds it.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import an issuing personalization design using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_issuing_personalization_design.standard
  id = "ipcd_1MvSieLkdIwHu7ixRtAhJoGu"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_issuing_personalization_design.standard
  identity = {
    id = "ipcd_1MvSieLkdIwHu7ixRtAhJoGu"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the issuing personalization design.

Using `terraform import`, import an issuing personalization design using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_issuing_personalization_design.standard ipcd_1MvSieLkdIwHu7ixRtAhJoGu
```
